request_routes.routing_notes: Iv rituximab indications span hematologic, oncologic, rheumatologic, neurologic, and transplant-related conditions; continuation requires confirming ongoing benefit or absence of toxicity.

request_routes.label: Rituximab and hyaluronidase (Rituxan Hycela)
request_routes.routing_notes: Rituxan Hycela initial and continuation coverage is limited to CD20-positive oncologic indications after a tolerable IV rituximab dose; continuation also requires ongoing toxicity evaluation.
request_routes.evidence: Section 'Rituximab and hyaluronidase (Rituxan Hycela)' specifies that Hycela is medically necessary for the same CD20-positive oncologic disorders in members who previously tolerated an IV rituximab dose, with continuation permitted when toxicity remains acceptable.

request_routes.label: Intrathecal/epidural catheter placement for rituximab administration
request_routes.routing_notes: Intra/epidural catheter placement for long-term rituximab administration is not covered as listed in the CPT table for excluded codes.
request_routes.evidence: The 'CPT codes not covered for indications listed in the CPB' table explicitly lists 62350 and 62351 as not covered.

section_path: CPT codes not covered for indications listed in the CPB

request_routes.label: Anti-chimeric antibody testing for rituximab therapy
request_routes.routing_notes: Anti-chimeric antibody or chimeric anti-TNF antibody testing in association with rituximab is considered investigational due to insufficient evidence.
request_routes.evidence: Experimental, Investigational, or Unproven I states that anti-chimeric antibody testing for rituximab therapy is experimental.

request_routes.label: Intrathecal rituximab administration
request_routes.routing_notes: Intrathecal administration of rituximab is investigational for progressive multiple sclerosis.
request_routes.evidence: Experimental, Investigational, or Unproven II states that intrathecal rituximab for progressive multiple sclerosis is experimental because effectiveness has not been established.

route_guards.label: Prior tolerable IV rituximab dose before Hycela
route_guards.evidence: Rituxan Hycela is considered medically necessary only in members who have received at least one full dose of an IV rituximab product without experiencing severe adverse reactions (Section I).

cluster_entry_guards.label: No concomitant biologic or targeted synthetic for RA
cluster_entry_guards.evidence: Exclusions A states that the member will not receive rituximab concurrently with any other biologic or targeted synthetic drug for rheumatoid arthritis.

cluster_entry_guards.label: No concomitant disease-modifying MS agents
